scripts.docker:dev:fresh-deps: docker rm -f shuttlementor-app-dev 2>/dev/null || true && docker volume prune -f --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shuttlementor-dev 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache app && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:redeploy: npm run docker:dev:stop && docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && npm run docker:dev
scripts.docker:dev:redeploy:detached: npm run docker:dev:stop && docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build && docker container prune -f
scripts.docker:prod: export $(grep -v '^#' .env.production | xargs) && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build
scripts.docker:prod:redeploy: npm run docker:prod:stop && docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && npm run docker:prod
scripts.docker:prod:redeploy:detached: npm run docker:prod:stop && docker image prune --filter until=168h -f && export $(grep -v '^#' .env.production | xargs) && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build && docker container prune -f
scripts.docker:images:prune:all: docker image prune -a -f && docker builder prune -f
scripts.docker:volumes:prune:dev: sh -c 'for name in shuttlementor-app-dev shuttlementor-db-dev; do docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -qx "$name" || { echo "Refusing to prune: expected running container $name"; exit 1; }; done; volumes=$(docker volume ls -q --filter dangling=true --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shuttlementor-dev | sort -u); if [ -z "$volumes" ]; then echo "No unused dev volumes to prune"; exit 0; fi; printf "%s\n" "$volumes" | xargs docker volume rm'
scripts.docker:volumes:prune:prod: sh -c 'for name in shuttlementor-app-prod shuttlementor-db-prod; do docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -qx "$name" || { echo "Refusing to prune: expected running container $name"; exit 1; }; done; volumes=$(docker volume ls -q --filter dangling=true --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shuttlementor-prod | sort -u); if [ -z "$volumes" ]; then echo "No unused prod volumes to prune"; exit 0; fi; printf "%s\n" "$volumes" | xargs docker volume rm'
scripts.docker:volumes:prune:all: npm run docker:volumes:prune:dev && npm run docker:volumes:prune:prod
scripts.docker:db:migrate:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:db:migrate:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:db:studio:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app npx prisma studio --port 5555
scripts.docker:db:studio:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app npx prisma studio --port 5556
